items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: He'd show you just what he wants you to do... he'd make you take out your method and go give you this lesson when you had to come back with that lesson.

ctx.x: Did it make you move your hand around like that?

No. No, it took your sticks. Just roll. Just roll? Just drop one stick. You see, roll is supposed to start with your left, man. Not your right. You like to jump the pick and roll the start with your right. The left hand. You just drop your stick on the pedal. Boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. And you make it go fast. And speed it up. The first thing you know you're rolling. Yeah. That's the way you should do. Did Mr. Contrell ever play with you or show you with…
You say he was very strict. In what way was he strict, Ali?
